scope: Read-only static followup of Goods/Learning reconciliation and App character-centre fix; no browser/UI/performance/compatibility/user save execution, no code/test/Git modification.

priorRedEvidence.meaning: Original two reported static risks now have actual root UI red reproduction on prior source; this agent did not run those cases.

resolvedBySourceInspection.assessment: The rows watcher finds the actual current pick index, resets to a valid first object if absent, otherwise page=floor(index/4). This covers same-life realm insertion and keeps the selected amount object in its visible directory. It does not mutate Game or plans. Explicit pagination still picks its page first object; filter/future resets remain read-only.

While skills mode is current, data-driven rows changes reconcile selected to a real row or empty, and reposition page to selected row. Queue, budget, reserve and editedLimits are untouched; same-life school change therefore no longer retains invalid current-school object in this active mode.

Character detail explicitly hides center-column under singleScreen rather than relying on :empty. Equipment KeepAlive wrapper no longer creates a visible empty flex sibling. The separate actual CharacterPanel remains outside this centre section; normal non-singleScreen path unchanged. Actual pixel/scroll resolution belongs to root UI evidence, not this static review.

remainingFinding.problem: A cached skills Draft restored after manual mode can reintroduce invalid selected/page after a same-life school update was already observed in manual mode. rows watcher explicitly returns while mode=manual; mode watcher later applies cached Draft but does not revalidate it. If restored filter/future equal current values, rows does not change again, so watcher never repairs restored selected.
remainingFinding.minimalFlow: Open sword skills with filter=current/future=false; switch manual (cache sword selected). While manual stays active, another page legally confirms talisman and the first page synchronizes current Game. rows changes to talisman while mode=manual and reconciliation skips. Return skills: cached filter/future are still current/false, selected restored to sword; rows unchanged, skill null despite valid talisman rows.
remainingFinding.impact: No write/fee/CAS defect; cached navigation can show false empty object stage in a legitimate sync boundary. Original primary red case does not establish this variant closed.
remainingFinding.recommendation: Extract a read-only reconcile function and run after applying/defaulting a skills mode draft as well as rows changes; keep queue/budget/reserve/saved-plan ownership intact. Verify this actual sync scenario if practical, or document why its trigger is impossible from current Store observer.

safetyReview: New reconciliation touches page/selection only; no changes to model/Store/Repository/command/period/DB in reviewed diff.
R2 parent clearInspections and inspectionOwner remain; accepted configuration/recovery frozen intents and original receipt retry are not cleared by the new local view reconciliation.
Same-run tick/paused activity still does not wipe queue/budget; source row recomputation may reposition view only to the same actual selected object.
Cross-run isolation remains root Equipment key runId/max1 plus nested child keys; existing new-life case covers actual separate-life budget isolation.
No new pixel or complete-matrix claims here; root red/green and exact final runtime identity required.
